question: Under pure behavior cloning at low NFE, with no critic at training or test time, how far can a policy get on OGBench cube-triple?

context_not_comparison.note: Published cube-triple-task4 numbers all use critics and must never be compared directly with these arms.

task.goal_relabeling: deterministic future state from the same episode only; identical rule to the puzzle adapter

backbone.note: parameter count differs from the puzzle pilots only through the 46-D observation dimension; exact counts are recorded per arm at run time and must agree within 1% across generative arms

training.checkpoint_selection: final fixed-step EMA checkpoint only; no selection on evaluation episodes

excluded_arms.improved_meanflow: cancelled; MVP (ICLR 2026) occupies the MeanFlow/cube-task intersection
excluded_arms.auxiliary_improved_meanflow: cancelled with the rest of the iMF line

stage_1.purpose: cheapest pair that can answer the question; BC floor plus the primary low-NFE arm

stage_2.purpose: multi-step ceiling, only if stage 1 shows non-trivial performance

stage_3.purpose: second low-NFE objective, only if the NFE axis proves discriminative

preregistered_outcomes.low_nfe_sufficient: Flow at 1-2 NFE approaches Flow at 8 and Gaussian at 100 -> NFE is not the bottleneck under BC on this task
preregistered_outcomes.nfe_matters: Flow collapses at 1-2 NFE and recovers by 4-8 -> integration/objective is the operative variable
preregistered_outcomes.bc_is_the_bottleneck: every arm including Gaussian@100 performs near zero -> BC without a critic cannot do this task, and the task cannot discriminate generative objectives for us; report and stop
preregistered_outcomes.bc_floor_matches: behavior_cloning matches the generative arms -> generative modeling is not earning its cost here; a publishable negative result

evaluation.environment: cube-triple-play singletask via the pinned native OGBench harness
evaluation.pairing_requirement: all arms evaluated on identical episode seeds; a per-arm hash over initial and goal states must match

reporting_rule: every published table must carry a paradigm column (BC / offline-RL / offline->online) and a test-time NFE column including critic calls
compute_gate: Run arms sequentially on one GPU. Stage 1 only is authorized by this manifest; stages 2 and 3 require the stage-1 result first. Do not launch while another process holds GPU memory.
